revisions.summary: Added recorded public-trace C++ transition checker; Jace ultimate was explicit coverage debt.
Closed Jace ultimate C++ trace debt with explicit shuffle transport and added a public-safe action-ranker imitation seed.
Refactored C++ recorded-trace checking into a reusable batch seam and evaluated a frozen public linear action-ranker policy under replay/promotion/statistical gates.
Added a JSON-backed tiny MLP public action-ranker and a mulligan policy gate; both new evaluation surfaces pass promotion/statistical/replay/C++ trace checks.
Added a JSON-backed learned mulligan ranker and evaluated learned-vs-rule mulligan agents under promotion/statistical/replay/C++ trace gates.
Added outcome-weighted public gameplay action-ranker training from terminal trajectories and evaluated outcome-ranker bundles under promotion/statistical/replay/C++ trace gates.
Split public-game agent RNG from transition RNG and added live C++ shadow rollout for batch parity checking public payoff traffic under promotion/statistical/replay gates.
Added terminal-outcome weighted mulligan ranker training, evaluated it as a first-class strategy-bundle component, and cached JSON-backed mulligan agents in public payoff loops.
Added paired opening-hand keep-vs-mulligan counterfactual probes from the same first seven-card look, plus explicit pregame-state construction and C++ transition parity over branch-game traffic.

Added repeated opening-hand keep-vs-mulligan branch rollouts, trained a repeated first-look counterfactual mulligan policy, and recorded start/end fingerprints for no-choice forced-action segments as the next C++ batching target.
Batched no-choice C++ segment finalization across a MAP-Elites variant payoff panel, fixed C++ segment actor refresh, and promoted segment-shadow rows through replay/promotion/statistical gates.
Added gameplay-action counterfactual branch labels for unchosen legal actions, trained/evaluated a first tiny counterfactual action ranker, and fixed a C++ combat/Jace sentinel parity bug.

Scaled gameplay action-counterfactual branch labels, added label-noise diagnostics, trained/evaluated a confidence-weighted rev0034 counterfactual action ranker, and generalized counterfactual ranker loading for future revisions.

Added budgeted high-branch gameplay action-counterfactual sampling, subset-label accounting, rev0035 counterfactual ranker aliases/evaluation, and C++ shadow checks over the new branch/payoff traffic.
Added adaptive/racing gameplay action-counterfactual labels, generic counterfactual ranker aliases, and a rev0036 public-safe ranker evaluated under replay/promotion/statistical/C++ shadow gates.

Added a matched fixed-vs-adaptive gameplay action-counterfactual label audit and a C++ no-choice segment-vs-one-action transport benchmark, with docs/tests/audit checks. No new policy was promoted; this revision strengthens label/C++ parity infrastructure.
Added disagreement-screened gameplay action-counterfactual labels and a rev0038 ranker smoke evaluation under replay/promotion/statistical/C++ gates.

Added a matched unscreened-vs-disagreement-screened gameplay action-counterfactual label audit. The same branch outcomes are consumed by both selectors; under a tight budget the vote-priority selector lost value in two sampled situations, so screening should guide frame selection but not replace diversity.

Added a hybrid branch selector and matched three-way selector audit. The smoke panel found all three selectors retained union-best actions, making this a neutral selector-infrastructure result and pointing next toward harder high-action/high-margin frames.
Added public-only hard-frame queue for action-counterfactual selector audits; targeted high-action/disagreement frames and C++-shadowed 24,016 branch transitions with zero mismatches.
Added a hard-frame fixed-vs-adaptive label-budget racing audit over the same branch outcome matrix; C++ shadow checks remain clean and no new gameplay policy is promoted.
Added live hard-frame online adaptive/racing branch allocation with allocation logs, decisive-label density metrics, and C++ transition shadows; no gameplay policy promoted.

Added public-feature margin-screen model for hard-frame queueing, refactored hard-frame racing into reusable selected-snapshot branch machinery, and archived a C++-shadowed margin-screened online branch-racing smoke run.

Added a matched hard-screen vs margin-screen queue audit over the same public hard-frame candidate pool. Only the union of selected situations is branched, so both queues are scored from the same branch outcomes. The margin screen did not improve decisive-label density in this smoke run; no gameplay policy is promoted.

Added a label-yield screen for counterfactual frame queueing. The model predicts decisive labels per rollout from public frame features. Hard, margin, and yield queues are compared on the same public candidate pool with union-branched outcomes and C++ transition shadow checks. No gameplay policy is promoted.

Added a terminal-clean payoff default for yield-ranker comparison, collected new yield-screened online branch labels, trained a rev0049 counterfactual action ranker, and evaluated it at max_decisions=900 with zero truncations plus replay/statistical/promotion/C++ shadow gates.
Added terminal-clean meta-rank / claim-ledger analysis over the full eight-strategy yield panel, with zero truncations, replay/statistical/promotion/meta gates, and clean C++ shadow checks.

Added focused terminal-clean deep repetitions around the rev0050 claim-ledger agenda, with target summaries, target-vs-opponent rows, promotion/statistical/meta/deep gates, replay samples, and clean C++ shadow checks.
Retested the largest rev0051 target/opponent life-total splits under terminal-clean settings; dramatic life splits softened, and no policy was promoted.
Converted rev0052 retested cells into a concrete confluence agenda and retested three target/opponent cells terminal-clean with replay samples and C++ shadow checks; no policy promoted.

Deepened the first concrete matchup candidate, cf34_counter_wall vs pub_threat_overlord, with a terminal-clean matchup dossier. The result is positive overall but life-sensitive, so future claim work should split by life total.

Split the rev0054 life-sensitive concrete matchup dossier into life-20 and life-40 target/opponent cells. Fresh terminal-clean games plus cumulative evidence with rev0054 now give both life cells life_cell_claim_candidate labels under the current gate.

Added a seed-disjoint holdout replication block for the rev0055 life-cell claim candidates. Both cf34_counter_wall vs pub_threat_overlord life cells replicated under terminal-clean max_decisions=900, replay, statistical, promotion, and C++ shadow gates.

Audited the heart of the MUC-5 mission, identified missing claim/explanation/maintenance layers, showed the replicated life-cell claim is mainly library-out/endurance, and added a cloudtainer cleanup policy without changing gameplay semantics.

Ran a concrete pilot/deck-size decomposition of the rev0056 cf34_counter_wall claim, added reusable terminal-mechanism/refactor modules, showed the edge follows the counter-wall/endurance shell more than the cf34 pilot in this panel, and shipped compact C++ transition evidence instead of another full raw transition CSV.

Ran a seed-disjoint A-D decomposition confirmation and a targeted life-20 A/B pilot-stress pass, exposing and then narrowing a life-20 contradiction while reinforcing the shell/endurance/library-out interpretation; refactored decomposition comparison/gate/sampling helpers and added a live revision artifact audit to prevent raw transition ballast.

Ran transition-level forensics over cumulative life-20 A/B games, sharpened the shell/endurance interpretation, found and fixed the terminal game-row decision-count overcount, and shipped compact feature evidence without raw transition ballast.

Ran a focused Jace/Counterspell/passive-buffer ablation and discovered that even an all-Island 60-card target is competitive against the 40-card Overlord shell, demoting the mechanism from active counter-wall play to mostly a 60-card library-buffer/self-deck exploit; refactored mechanism-ablation helpers and broadened forensic decision-count validation for old and new artifacts.

Ran legal 40/60-card active and inert library-buffer controls, showing life-40 legacy threat results were dominated by closure/self-deck pathology while active components still mattered in selected life-20 cells.
Added a public library-aware threat_closure audit profile that reduced Jace/Overlord overdraw and sharply cut inert-buffer wins without changing simulator semantics.
Reran active counter-wall controls against threat_closure and found the historical edge collapsed across every tested size/life cell, quarantining the old fixed-opponent claim.

Added the public counter_guard response, a stress panel, and live quarantine tables; it rescued selected cells against threat_closure without rehabilitating the historical threat_rush-dependent claim.
Fixed accidental own-spell counter targeting in guarded public policies and tested counter_guard against a stronger threat_pressure response; the rescue remained mixed and policy-sensitive.
Added threat_surge and an explicit closure/pressure/surge response matrix. counter_guard remained a live but underpowered candidate; 60-vs-60 life-40 became the main threat-side pressure point.

Reframed MUC-5 as an adversarial claim-testing instrument, repaired package identity and revision governance, fixed incomplete-matrix false-zero classification, added an executable package contract and claim registry, and established an evidence-budget migration plan.

Added a complete pilot population frontier over legacy/public counter policies versus closure/pressure/surge threat policies; fixed the broader missing-cell comparison bug class; and added a dependency-scanned evidence migration index.

Added a replicated population precision gate that rejects noisy security claims, tightened semantic matrix completeness, sampled 30,000 C++ transition checks from 51,750 generated transitions, and split evidence-index references into active blockers versus historical generated-data mentions.

Pooled the seed-disjoint rev0069+rev0070 population panels into a precision-sufficient low-floor quarantine and created compact derivatives for the remaining rev0070 missing-derivative evidence blockers.

Fixed the rev0071 store-only ZIP regression, added a deterministic archive-size contract, and moved 72 hash-verified historical bulk artifacts into a reversible cold evidence sidecar while retaining six row-level audit dependencies in core.
Exact maximin promotion math for current 2x3 population games, pooling robustness cuts, and revision-agnostic evidence tier catalog discovery.

Recomputed population arm summaries from raw rev0069/rev0070 games, introduced source-qualified game ids after finding a local C++ shadow id collision, and added fine source-size-life stratum guards that keep high-point tiny strata quarantined as underpowered.

Stress-tested high-point underpowered population strata with 288 seed-disjoint games, fixed CSV-safe gate booleans and context-axis grouping, and kept selected cells quarantined under the conservative floor.
Audited target score/result/terminal orientation for 720 live population raw games, centralized target-seat score annotation, and confirmed zero mismatches across balanced seat flips.

Added an adaptive sampling-frame guard that excludes rev0075 targeted stratum-challenge rows from broad pooled promotion gates, quantified the naive-pooling LCB shift, and kept the new evidence compact.

Added matrix-familywise Bonferroni Hoeffding intervals for population promotion gates, compared ordinary and simultaneous uncertainty on the complete broad pool, and kept the public_counter_guard quarantine intact under stricter bounds.

Added hierarchical familywise population gates across global/life/size/fine layers, exposed size-precision and fine underpower blockers, and replaced small multi-row zero-sum fallback with exact support enumeration before policy-population expansion.

Ran a five-rep seed-disjoint complete population outcome ladder that clears size and fine size/life power blockers, keeps all hierarchy rows quarantined for low conservative floor, and adds reusable power-allocation math for future panels.
Added a threat-column opponent-frontier audit that explains the rev0080 low-floor result across all named threat axes, with fail-closed column diagnostics and compact artifacts only.
Added a rescue-envelope audit that distinguishes certification-limited threat-column failures from current counter-set deficiency under familywise upper/lower bounds.

Added a seed-paired targeted counterprobe and low-life stabilizer profile for the only rev0082 upper-bound-deficient fine cell; the cell reclassifies as certification-limited, while the candidate ties the existing guard and remains excluded from broad pools.

rev0084 runs a seed-disjoint selected-cell holdout and broader transfer audit for the adaptive rev0083 public_counter_life20_stabilizer candidate; the candidate shows negative transfer versus public_counter_guard and is machine-quarantined from broad counter populations.

rev0085 audits the rev0084 adaptive stabilizer transfer evidence for pair integrity, exact paired sign-test support, and same-score terminal-mechanism drift; it keeps the candidate quarantined but narrows the reason to transfer-panel exact-sign failure rather than an overstated selected-cell holdout claim.

rev0086 adds a mechanism-aware tie contract for the adaptive stabilizer transfer evidence: score ties are separated from score+mechanism equivalence, and same-score flips show a familywise-supported drift toward candidate library-out endings.
Mechanism-aware candidate firewall prevents adaptive counter candidates from entering broad or candidate pools unless paired score, mechanism, and pool-leak gates all pass.
Dynamic design-family correction and explicit row-schema contract harden adaptive candidate evidence against future sampling-design or pool-flag leaks.

Deterministic policy/runtime replay guard checks sampled historical population/adaptive rows against current code, records a runtime identity digest, and makes the inherited name-only policy identity gap explicit while adding future row digests.

Deep mission reassessment identifies claim autopsy as the core mission, elevates the missing perfect-recall information-state/public-event contract as the main scientific blocker, quantifies cognitive and storage debt, and corrects sidecar verification/availability semantics without changing game behavior.

Implements the current information-state boundary with public/private event streams, persistent Jace +2 known-top-card semantics, public Force pitch exile identity, and replay-checked information-state fingerprints without promoting a new strategic policy.

Adds episode-safe policy lifecycle and the first executable finite-oracle PSRO expansion. A diverse archived deck survives disjoint response confirmation, an information-state ablation assigns the gain to deck search, and support pruning removes exact-zero mixture rollouts.

Adds the first reduced tabular CFR calibration game with information-set-safe exploitability measurement, and refactors PSRO mixture-support pruning into a centralized tested helper without promoting a new full-game strategy.

Stress-tests the rev0092 admitted PSRO response with a second static-catalog oracle, adds bounded effective-support pruning for tiny solver residue, and refactors response-population/candidate reconstruction into shared package code without promoting a new strategy.

Implements a gameplay-driven generative MAP-Elites response oracle, evaluates 44 nonduplicate generated candidates against the effective PSRO support, finds only a nonconfirmed point-estimate challenger, and adds descriptor/archive/duplicate tests without promoting a strategy.

Reactivates the frozen rev0023 MLP as a bounded neural response oracle against the current effective PSRO support, records a negative-control result, and refactors shared oracle-reporting helpers without promoting a strategy.

Adds a rollout-searched learned response oracle with registry-backed information-state agents, records training/selection overfit rejected by holdout, and extends audit/spec coverage without promoting a strategy.
Added cross-oracle selection-to-holdout optimism audit and a common-target frontier retest of branch winners; no challenger cleared confidence lower bound for admission.

Centralized balanced focal-pair evaluation design and refreshed the nine-strategy expanded empirical matrix with 2,880 balanced rows; admitted response remains the only effective support target, with no promotion.

Separated self-diagonal matrix floor from non-self opponent floor and remeasured the admitted PSRO response against eight incumbents at 240 balanced rows per pair; fixed-population confidence floor clears, with no strategic promotion.

Stress-tested the admitted PSRO response against a 13-opponent OOD panel; it survives in mean but does not clear transfer confidence because ood_counter_jace40 is weak and one counter-control/Jace seed remains nonterminal after rescue.

Added count-only long-game snapshots, deterministic cap-ladder replay for the rev0101 truncated counter/Jace cell, and a high-cap ood_counter_jace40 axis refresh. Persistent cap debt remains; no strategy promoted.
